items.q: What is PDRN and how does it benefit the skin?
items.a: PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) is made of DNA fragments that are bio compatible with human skin cells. It promotes natural cell regeneration, stimulates microcirculation, and helps repair the skin barrier, for brighter, firmer looking skin.

items.q: How do I incorporate PDRN Brightening Serum into my skincare routine?
items.a: Use PDRN Brightening Serum twice daily after cleansing and toning. Dispense 2 to 4 drops directly onto fingertips or damp skin, smoothing across the face, neck, and décolletage. Follow with your moisturizer and morning sunscreen.

items.q: Is this serum suitable for sensitive and acne prone skin?
items.a: Yes. Our formulation is non comedogenic, oil free, fragrance free, and enriched with soothing Panthenol. It calms sensitivity while hydrating deeply without clogging pores or triggering irritation.

items.q: Can I layer PDRN with retinol, vitamin C, or AHA/BHA?
items.a: Yes. PDRN works well alongside active treatments like retinoids and vitamin C. Its hydrating base helps soothe the flaking or redness that chemical exfoliants can cause.

items.q: How long does one 30ml bottle typically last?
items.a: When applied at 2 to 4 drops twice daily, one 30ml (1 fl oz) bottle typically lasts 4 to 6 weeks. Subscribe and Save sends the next bottle before you run out.

research.slopeAria: Slope chart showing total acne lesions from 16.8 at baseline to 6.2 at week 16
research.slopeNote: A straight line between the two measured points only. The report did not publish outcome values for weeks 4, 8, or 12.

badges.small: Clinical texture score, 2.7 of 4 to 1.3 of 4

research.resultsSub: Results for the 84 participants who completed all visits. Each card compares the two time points the study actually measured.
research.participantsTitle: Who took part in the program.
research.participantsSub: Five visits across the program, from baseline through week 16.
research.genderAria: Gender split donut chart, 74 percent female, 24 percent male, 2 percent non binary
research.donutNote: Donut animates to the reported split when it scrolls into view.
research.concernsNote: Participants could report more than one concern, so these shares do not add to 100 percent.
research.programTitle: The 16 week program, step by step.
research.programSub: Participants received in person screening, product dispensing, application coaching, and follow up assessments at a clinical research site.
pmSteps: Retinol 0.3 percent, introduced in week 2 and titrated under clinician guidance
research.routineNote: Retinol was used 3 to 5 nights weekly after the initial two week ramp up period. As needed, 2 percent salicylic acid was used for active lesions.
research.supplementSub: Two capsules daily with breakfast. Amounts shown per two capsule serving.
research.supplementNote: Optional addition, Omega 3, one softgel daily.
nutritionItems: At least 2.5 L of water daily
Vegetables, berries, and omega 3 rich foods
Limit added sugar and high glycemic foods
Optional two week low dairy, low sugar reset
Baseline counseling with a registered dietitian
lifestyleItems: At least 150 minutes of moderate activity per week
Hydration and sunscreen habits reviewed at visits
research.adherenceTitle: How closely people stayed on plan.
research.adherenceSub: Adherence across the full 16 weeks, as recorded in the report.
research.safetySub: Shares of participants reporting each effect during the program.
research.alertBody: That line is stated in the report alongside the mild effects listed on this page. It is included here exactly as reported.
research.photoSub: Side by side photographs from the four month program. The left image in each pair showed baseline and the right image showed week 16. No participant photographs are reproduced on this page.
research.photoProtocol: Standardized capture at baseline and follow up using a fixed camera setup, consistent visible and cross polarized lighting, frontal, 45 degree, and profile angles, and a color calibrated background.
methods: Texture grading on a 0 to 4 scale
research.source: Source, Tava Labs Participant Outcomes, Research Series 001, 16 week participant program. This page presents the report numbers only, with baseline and week 16 as the two measured outcome points.

labTab.title: Know your numbers.
labTab.sub: Real blood panels, ordered under your Tava account. Browse the panels, see every marker before you order, and get your results delivered right here.

lab.ordersEmpty: Nothing here yet. When you complete a panel, every marker lands here with its value, its healthy range, and how it moves over time. Order your first panel below and this space fills in.

steps.title: Choose a panel

steps.title: Physician review
steps.body: A licensed physician reviews and authorizes every order, so no separate doctor visit is needed.

steps.title: Walk in for your draw
steps.body: One quick blood draw at a collection site near you. Most visits take about fifteen minutes.

steps.title: Results land here
steps.body: Results are delivered digitally into this tab in days, with every marker and its range.

lab.panelsTitle: Fourteen panels, built around what you track
lab.panelsSub: Every panel shows its price. Ordering opens once checkout is switched on, and a licensed physician reviews every order before your results are delivered right here. Panels cannot be ordered for addresses in New York, New Jersey, or Rhode Island.
lab.disclaimer: Lab insights are information about your own health and are not a diagnosis. Talk to your doctor about any result that concerns you, and call 911 in an emergency.
